rationale: A calendar with nine zero-length dots: 13 elements, one over the icon limit. medium.icon_elements fires (true positive, covering a check that had no probe). Note the dots are the legitimate Lucide 'h.01' idiom; a subpath/stroke counter must not confuse them with sub-pixel detail (they render as 2px round dots). Bonus at 16px: the dot rows are 3px apart (1px gap), so the columns fuse into vertical bars; another min_gap case the critic cannot see.
